input.command: for f in paypal stripepayment; do rg -n -B8 "convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit,$" packages/app-store/$f/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx | rg "from|import"; done; rg -n "from" packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts | rg -i currency; sed -n 1,30p packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts; rg -n "currencyOptions|currencyConversions" packages/app-store/btcpayserver/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx; rg -n "convertToSmallest|currencyConversions" packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts

content.text:
`convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit` from `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts` is used in the files below. The two test files only mention it in comments. I checked this by searching for the name and reading each file's imports.

**Code that imports it from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions`:**
- `packages/features/bookings/lib/handlePayment.ts` calls it on the add-on price when totalling the payment amount.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts` calls it on the parsed amount.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it when setting the price.
- `packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it when setting the price.
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it when setting the price.

**Test files that mention it only in comments:**
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts`
- `packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts`

No test file calls the function or imports it directly. These two only describe how it stores the price.

**Same-named functions that are not the `packages/lib` one:**
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts` defines its own copy. The hitpay files above import from `@calcom/lib`, so nothing in the repo imports this copy.
- `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/currencyOptions.ts` defines its own copy, which `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports and uses.

I left those two defining files and the btcpayserver component out of the list below.

<files>
packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts
packages/features/bookings/lib/handlePayment.ts
packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts
packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts
packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx
packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx
packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts
packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx
</files>
